title: SATORP 朱拜勒煉油廠
summary: SATORP 是朱拜勒的煉油整合案例；課程以煉油與下游使用者之間的產品、熱量及公用系統接口建模。本課依序分析煉製產品分配、氫氣供需與純度、下游熱源匹配、跨企業邊界量測、中間產品緩衝，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: SATORP is a Jubail refining case; teaching models product, heat and utility interfaces between refining and downstream users. The course analyses refinery product allocation, hydrogen supply demand and purity, matching heat sources to downstream sinks, metering across organizational boundaries, intermediate-product buffering, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 煉製產品分配、氫氣供需與純度、下游熱源匹配
v31FocusEn: Refinery product allocation; Hydrogen supply demand and purity; Matching heat sources to downstream sinks

quiz.question: 關於「煉製產品分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Refinery product allocation" is correct?
options: 煉製產品分率是質量帳的分類，不是把原油簡單按名稱切開；氣體、液體、焦炭與損失都應納入同一基準。
產品總體積大於原料體積就表示違反質量守恆。
壓縮機循環量就是每日必須採購的新鮮氫氣量。
optionsEn: Refinery product fractions classify a mass balance; crude is not merely separated by product names.
Product volume exceeding feed volume violates mass conservation.
Compressor recycle flow equals daily purchased fresh hydrogen demand.

steps.title: 煉製產品分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Refinery product allocation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「煉製產品分配」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Refinery product allocation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：M = Feed yield；代入 F = 31500 tonne/day feed、y = 0.35 mass fraction product yield，得 11,025 t/day（「煉製產品分配」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 y 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M = Feed yield; with F = 31500 tonne/day feed, y = 0.35 mass fraction product yield the result is 11,025 t/day (simplified exercise for Refinery product allocation; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise y by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：y 增加 10% 時，結果變為 12,128 t/day（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising y by 10% changes the result to 12,128 t/day (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 11,025 t/day（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 y 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 11,025 t/day (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in y with an engineering explanation.

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

steps.title: 煉製產品分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Refinery product allocation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「煉製產品分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Refinery product allocation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「煉製產品分配」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把假設產品分率加總至一，檢查質量收率與體積收率是否被混用；再以原料變動情境重算所有產品。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Refinery product allocation”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Sum assumed product fractions to one, check for mixing mass and volume yields, and recalculate all products for a feed-change scenario. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 043-01 標記，圖表須寫明「SATORP 朱拜勒煉油廠：教學假設」。交付質量與體積兩張分開的表，以密度關聯並標示品質與商業規格未由本模型驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 043-01 and mark charts “SATORP Jubail refinery: teaching assumptions”. Deliver separate mass and volume tables connected by density, noting that product quality and commercial specification remain unverified by this model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「煉製產品分配」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Refinery product allocation” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 煉製產品分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Refinery product allocation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「煉製產品分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Refinery product allocation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「煉製產品分配」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。密度較低的成品可能使體積收率超過百分之百，這不等於創造質量；漏列氣體或焦炭則會使質量帳無法閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「SATORP 朱拜勒煉油廠」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Refinery product allocation” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Lower-density products may produce volume yield above one hundred percent without creating mass; omitting gas or coke prevents the mass account from closing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “SATORP Jubail refinery”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：簡化收率模型只估算一項產品的質量，不宣稱分餾或轉化設備的真實產率。
